q: 我昨天给小狗买___两个玩具。
en: Yesterday I bought two toys for my puppy.

q: 上个周末她看___三部电影，都很好看。
en: Last weekend she watched three films, and all of them were good.

q: 今天早上弟弟在公园里拍___很多小鸟的照片，非常开心。
en: This morning my little brother took lots of photos of birds in the park and was very happy.

q: 老师给我们放___一首很老的歌。
en: The teacher played us a very old song.

q: 我们在湖边坐___一个小时，才回家。
en: We sat by the lake for an hour before going home.

q: 昨天晚上他读___那本小说的最后三章，然后才睡觉。
en: Last night he read the last three chapters of that novel before going to sleep.

q: 我养的猫昨晚抓___一只老鼠。
en: My cat caught a mouse last night.

q: 她唱___两首歌就下台了。
en: She sang two songs and then left the stage.

q: 妈妈上星期给我寄___一本书。
en: Last week Mom sent me a book.

q: 去年春天我们在山上种___三棵树。
en: Last spring we planted three trees on the hill.

q: 春天来了，天气暖和___。
en: Spring is here and the weather has turned warm.

q: 我家的小狗已经三岁___。
en: Our puppy is already three.

q: 学了一年吉他，他终于会弹这首歌___。
en: After a year of guitar he can finally play this song.

q: 电影快要开始___，你怎么还不来？
en: The film is about to start; why haven't you come yet?

q: 雨停___，我们去山上看鸟吧。
en: The rain has stopped; let's go up the hill to look at birds.

q: 我的小兔子长大___，现在比我的手还大。
en: My bunny has grown up and is now even bigger than my hand.

q: 秋天到了，树叶都黄___。
en: Autumn has come and the leaves have all turned yellow.

q: 已经十点___，小猫还没回家。
en: It's already ten o'clock and the cat still isn't home.

q: 这只狗我已经养___三年___，它还是不听话。
en: I've had this dog for three years now and it still doesn't listen.

q: 去年夏天我在海边住___两个月___，后来就回北京了。
en: Last summer I lived by the sea for two months and then went back to Beijing.

q: 他从早上到现在已经弹___三个小时钢琴___，手都累了。
en: He has been playing the piano for three hours since this morning, and his hands are tired.

q: 小狗在门口等___你一个下午___，现在还在那儿呢。
en: The puppy has waited for you all afternoon and is still there now.

q: 你看___这部电影就告诉我好不好看。
en: Tell me whether it's good as soon as you've seen this film.

q: 我们喂___小狗再出门。
en: Let's feed the puppy first and then go out.

q: 下___课，我们就去公园看天鹅。
en: As soon as class is over, we'll go to the park to see the swans.

q: 你读___这本书再借给我吧。
en: Read this book first, then lend it to me.

q: 他昨天下___班就去看电影了。
en: Yesterday he went to a film right after work.

q: 明天我起___床就去遛狗。
en: Tomorrow I'll take the dog for a walk as soon as I get up.

q: 回到家，我先喝___水再喂猫。
en: When I get home I'll have some water first and then feed the cat.

q: 我小时候每个周末都去___山里看鸟。
en: When I was little I went to the mountains every weekend to watch birds.

q: 爷爷以前每天早上都听___京剧。
en: Grandpa used to listen to Peking opera every morning.

q: 他常常在晚上弹___吉他，邻居都习惯了。
en: He often plays guitar at night, and the neighbours are used to it.

q: 我家的狗平时一天吃___两顿饭。
en: My dog usually eats two meals a day.

q: 老师每个星期五都教我们唱___一首新歌，大家都很喜欢。
en: Every Friday the teacher taught us a new song, and everyone liked it.

q: 昨天我___去公园，因为下雨了。
en: I didn't go to the park yesterday because it rained.

q: 他还___吃早饭，肚子很饿。
en: He hasn't eaten breakfast yet, and he's very hungry.

q: 上个月我没看___那部电影。
en: I didn't see that film last month.

q: 小猫今天没吃___早饭。
en: The kitten didn't eat its breakfast today.

q: 我们昨晚没去听___音乐会，因为票卖完了。
en: We didn't go to the concert last night because the tickets were sold out.

q: 弟弟没有给鱼喂___食，所以鱼都饿了。
en: My brother didn't feed the fish, so they're all hungry.

q: 去年冬天很冷___，河都结冰了。
en: Last winter was very cold and the river froze over.

q: 我觉得___那本小说很有意思。
en: I thought that novel was very interesting.

q: 他小时候喜欢___养鸟。
en: He liked keeping birds when he was little.

q: 上个星期天我在___公园，没在家。
en: Last Sunday I was at the park, not at home.

q: 那只猫以前是___邻居的宠物。
en: That cat used to be a neighbour's pet.

q: 她那时候有___一只很大的狗。
en: She had a very big dog back then.

q: 这条路太远___，你骑车去吧。
en: This road is too far; go by bike.

q: 这部电影太长___，我看到一半就睡着了。
en: This film was so long that I fell asleep halfway through.

q: 你的小狗太聪明___，什么都学得会！
en: Your dog is so clever, it can learn anything!

q: 这个房间不太大___，放不下钢琴。
en: This room isn't very big, so the piano won't fit.

q: 这首歌非常好听___，我听了三遍。
en: This song is really nice; I listened to it three times.

q: 湖边的鸟太多___，我们数不清。
en: There are too many birds by the lake; we can't count them.

q: 医生说他不能喝咖啡，所以他现在___喝咖啡了。
en: The doctor said he can't have coffee, so he doesn't drink it any more.

q: 我___听流行歌了，现在喜欢听古典音乐。
en: I don't listen to pop songs any more; now I like classical music.

q: 天太黑了，我们___去森林里看鸟了。
en: It's too dark; we're not going to look at birds in the forest after all.
